PDF FORM INFORMATION
===================

File: sample-form.pdf
Location: tests/test-workspace/sample-form.pdf

Form Type: IRS Form W-4 (Employee's Withholding Certificate)
Version: 2025
Source: https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fw4.pdf
Downloaded: November 16, 2024
File Size: 188 KB

FORM FIELD TYPES PRESENT:
------------------------
✓ AcroForm structure (confirmed via PDF inspection)
✓ Annotations layer (confirmed)
✓ Text input fields (name, address, SSN, etc.)
✓ Checkbox fields (filing status, multiple jobs, etc.)
✓ Widget annotations (interactive form elements)

EXPECTED FORM FIELDS:
--------------------
Based on IRS Form W-4 structure, this form should contain:

1. Text Inputs:
   - First name and middle initial
   - Last name
   - Address
   - City or town, state, and ZIP code
   - Social security number (SSN)
   - Multiple numbered line items for tax calculations

2. Checkboxes:
   - Single or Married filing separately
   - Married filing jointly
   - Head of household
   - Multiple jobs or spouse works checkbox
   - Other dependent checkbox options

3. Signature Fields:
   - Employee's signature (may be a special field type)
   - Date field

PDF.JS RENDERING:
----------------
When this PDF is opened in the application's PDF viewer:
- PDF.js will render the form pages as canvases
- An annotation layer will be created on top
- Interactive HTML form elements will be generated:
  * <input type="text"> for text fields
  * <input type="checkbox"> for checkboxes
  * <textarea> for multi-line text areas
- These elements will have the CSS class "annotationLayer"
- Form fields can be filled using standard web interaction

TESTING:
--------
The Playwright tests can interact with these fields using standard selectors:
- .annotationLayer input[type="text"]
- .annotationLayer input[type="checkbox"]
- .annotationLayer textarea

And standard Playwright methods:
- fill() - to enter text
- click() - to interact with elements
- check() - to check checkboxes
- inputValue() - to read text values
- isChecked() - to verify checkbox state

VERIFICATION:
------------
To verify the PDF has form fields, you can:

1. Open in Adobe Reader/Acrobat - form fields should be visible and fillable
2. Use PDF inspection tools - look for /AcroForm and /Annots in PDF structure
3. Open in the application - PDF.js should render the annotation layer
4. Run the Playwright tests - all form field tests should pass

This is a production-quality government form, perfect for testing real-world
PDF form filling capabilities.
